name: Release Registry
scope: Versioned Ultra Brain release identities and their governed artifact locations.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.1 Foundation
entities.scope: Governance, architecture, registry, validation, release, and workspace-protection foundation; no operational Meta OS or UI implementation.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.2 Safety
entities.scope: Safety Core Meta OS validation, integrity, monitoring, risk, logging, audit, backup, recovery, execution-safety, and incident-management baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.3 Enhancement
entities.scope: Enhancement Core Meta OS analytics, bounded learning, patterns, knowledge candidates, optimization, draft rules, prediction, insight, and advisory decision-support baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.4 Automation
entities.scope: Automation Core Meta OS controlled workflows, triggers, scheduling, routines, registered local execution, typed decisions, pipelines, bounded batches, and local notification baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.5 Collaboration & Connectivity
entities.scope: Collaboration & Connectivity Core Meta OS governed connector, credential-reference, data portability, synchronization, external-AI, repository, communication, and ecosystem exchange baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.6 Personal Secretary
entities.scope: Personal Secretary Core Meta OS consent-aware briefing, review, reminder, recommendation, priority, decision, assistance, context, and scheduling-support baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.61 Personal Secretary Architecture Hotfix
entities.scope: Architecture recovery for operational reporting, Database Reports, OS Ecosystem support, approval and outcome flow, and failure/recovery/rollback support without runtime change.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.7 OS Ecosystem Integration
entities.scope: Formal independent OS Ecosystem v0.73 registry, management interface and contract, dependency validation, operational-report flow, and non-UI navigation structure.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.8 Official UI Foundation
entities.scope: World-first Ultra Brain UI foundation with the registered OS Ecosystem entry and preview-first UI system boundary.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.9 Official UI / UX Final
entities.scope: Production-ready Official UI/UX with UI Studio, twelve theme profiles, custom theme import, Layout Editor, propagation controls, preview, and rollback.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.91 Hierarchy Propagation Final
entities.scope: Production hierarchy propagation from Ultra Brain through Feature with automatic application, target-level Override, Lock, preview, and child editor boundaries.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.92 Official Theme System
entities.scope: Registry-driven official Theme Packages with detail adjustments, presets, preview, import preparation, export preparation, and existing hierarchy propagation.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.93 Layout & Custom UI
entities.scope: Production UI polish, Korean-first operational controls, governed Layout Editor, six lock types, preview, rollback, and preserved hierarchy propagation.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.94 User Custom UI & Canvas Editor
entities.scope: User Custom UI and Canvas Editor with direct drawing, image asset import, component placement, layer controls, nine lock types, preview, save/apply/rollback, and a local User Custom Theme registry while preserving Official Theme concept-art language.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.95 Advanced Theme & Visual World Engine
entities.scope: Registry-driven visual world themes that reinterpret the existing concept art with world-specific atmosphere, layout language, texture, lighting, typography, component treatment, motion, Theme Browser previews, and Theme Detail controls.
